news.title: Incoming public hearing on data center moratorium - The Journal

quotes.text: I think this is a good idea to put the brakes on for a minute and catch your breath and get ourselves lined up the way we should be,

facts: Brown County Board of Commissioners set a public hearing for Nov. 17 at 9:02 a.m. on an interim ordinance for a data center moratorium.
The proposed moratorium would impose a one-year block on permitting, expanding, or establishing data centers in Brown County's unincorporated areas.

facts: Nobles County Planning Commission held a work session with Geronimo Power on a potential data center
Geronimo plans to begin an Alternative Urban Areawide Review (AUAR) before end of 2025 if the County consents
Geronimo has approximately 2.8GW of wind and solar in operation or under construction in Minnesota
Target completion for a 400MW data center is 2030; end user could be secured as soon as 2027
First 30-day public comment period of the AUAR runs until 4 p.m. April 16
The proposed data center is in Section 19 of Elk Township, Nobles County
Geronimo Power plans a 400-megawatt data center that could go up to 1,000 megawatts
The entire site represents 0.2% of the ag land in Nobles County, per Nixon
Geronimo Power has a signed purchase agreement with landowners in Section 19 of Elk Township
Geronimo Power plans a $4 billion data center campus near Brewster and Reading in Nobles County, Minnesota
The project has not yet secured an anchor tenant, which is the key step required before construction can move forward
The initial phase is estimated to create about 1,000 construction jobs and about 180 full-time operational positions
A future expansion could add $6 billion in investment
